mapper.select: SELECT steel_strip_code, GROUP_CONCAT(M.MACHINE_ID ORDER BY M.MACHINE_ID SEPARATOR ',') MACHINE_ID FROM T_CD15_SPECIFY_MACHINE M LEFT JOIN T_CD15_MACHINE_INFO MI ON MI.ID = M.MACHINE_ID WHERE M.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND MI.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND MI.STATUS = '0' AND M.JOB_TYPE = #{jobType} GROUP BY steel_strip_code
SELECT ID, MACHINE_CODE, MACHINE_NAME, QUATA, CLASS_SHIFT, OPEN_MACHINE_CLASS, IS_OUT_TWO, STEEL_STRIP_WIDTH, STATUS, DEL_FLAG, REMARK FROM T_CD15_MACHINE_INFO WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' AND STATUS = '0'

SELECT cd.STEEL_STRIP_CODE1 steel_strip_code, max(MACHINE_ID) MACHINE_ID FROM T_CD15_SCHEDULE_RESULT cd WHERE SCHEDULE_DATE = DATE_ADD(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL -1 DAY) AND DEL_FLAG = '0' AND NIGHT_PLAN_QTY1 > 0 AND steel_strip_code1 is not null AND MACHINE_ID is not null GROUP BY steel_strip_code1 UNION SELECT cd.STEEL_STRIP_CODE2 steel_strip_code, max(MACHINE_ID) MACHINE_ID FROM T_CD15_SCHEDULE_RESULT cd WHERE SCHEDULE_DATE = DATE_ADD(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL -1 DAY) AND DEL_FLAG = '0' AND NIGHT_PLAN_QTY1 > 0 AND steel_strip_code1 is null AND MACHINE_ID is not null GROUP BY steel_strip_code2
